method: nw.exe harness (--deus-test=bench_combat_srd) on a snapshot copy of game/ under %TEMP%. The copy's DEUS_Test watchdog is raised from 180 s to 600 s so a day/night base pass and a day/night SRD pass fit in one process. Fighters carry SRD stat-block ids from tools/bench/combat_srd/roster.js. Resolution is UF.Rules.attack and UF.Rules.damage (host resolveAttack when the catalog weapon key is that action). sim.rules and render are separate timers. The driver is a due bucket; resolution.fullScans counts roster walks. Machine load: runs[].machineLoad.

target.rule: met when the median frame interval is at most 16.7 ms (WG.00.09b over-budget line; a 60 Hz frame is 16.666... ms)

costs.note: sim.rules is time inside UF.Rules.attack and UF.Rules.damage. render is time inside the engine render submission. The two accumulators are independent. sim.rules is not render subtracted from the frame.

arrow.note: arrow in flight: no arrow sprite in the game

spellOrb.note: spell projectile in flight: no spell projectile in the game

impactLower.note: impact on a lower level: RMMZ animations need a Game_Event

effectPaths.melee: host resolveAttack when the catalog key matches the stat-block action; otherwise UF.Rules.attack
effectPaths.arrows: visual placeholder; the SRD ranged attack resolves on the due frame
effectPaths.spells: printed spell action through UF.Rules (hurl flame, shock, life drain); visual orb
effectPaths.sustain: bench onUnitDeath counts a killing blow and restores printed HP so the unit stays in the window

engine.note: worldUpdateCalls counts UF.World.update. That function walks every unit (DEUS_World.js). This bench does not change it. fullScans counts combat-roster walks by the stress driver.

machineLoad.label: loaded
machineLoad.labelRule: quiet: overall median CPU <= 25 % and no other nw.exe at the start, in any 15 s check or at the end; otherwise loaded
machineLoad.method: CPU: os.cpus() idle/total time deltas over all logical CPUs, one sample a second. aiWorkers: PowerShell CIM, claude.exe with ' -p ', grok.exe, node.exe running codex.js exec (the PM's filter); the session running this bench counts as 1. otherNwExe: nw.exe processes that are not this run's own.
